d: Short, vibrant crimson hair is styled in a sweeping, upturned pompadour with a clean part. The eyes are closed in a peaceful, smiling expression on a youthful, soft-featured face. This slight build is dressed in a teal-colored hooded tunic with a matching oversized hood, a short dark brown skirt, and teal boots with light grey cuffs. Accessories include a wooden staff with a gold bell and small green leaves, a bandolier of small colorful potion vials, and a brown leather bag resting on a wooden crate. BODY COLOR: Peach LEGS: Plantigrade with flat feet.
